parameters.question: Compare HOMER annotatePeaks.pl output tables for ChIP-seq peaks annotated with nearest gene. For each peak (matched by peak ID or chr/start/end coordinates), the genomic coordinates (Chr, Start, End), Distance to TSS, and nearest gene name/ID must match the reference. Row order and extra HOMER annotation columns (e.g., CpG%, GC%, detailed annotation, focus ratio) may differ and should be ignored.
